The chain map t:E→T is the quotient in degreea, the identity in degreesa<j≤b, and zero belowa. It commutes with differentials because B^a is the image of d_E^(a−1). For any right module N over the pulled-back base ring, U is a bounded flat complex, so H^a(N⊗^L U)=0. This group is Tor_1(N,M). Its vanishing for every N proves h-flatness, exactly as I5.1.1 states.
